purpose: Off-machine backup of single-copy production / Blind-B-critical cache artifacts (Mac disk is tight; these are not in git and not otherwise duplicated).
restore: Extract each tarball at the repo root: `tar -xzf <name>.tar.gz` (paths are repo-relative, e.g. cache/...).

tarballs.name: r54_phase3_fold0_model_and_embs.tar.gz
tarballs.why: Fold 0 of the R54 phase-3 5-fold ensemble retriever. SINGLE-COPY (folds 1-4 are separately backed up as r54_phase3_full_folds1_4.zip).

tarballs.name: r54_phase3_lr_support.tar.gz
tarballs.why: The R54c LightGBM ranker + ALS factors + payload maps + track popularity. The ranker is irreplaceable without a full retrain.

tarballs.name: production_retrieval_lists.tar.gz
tarballs.why: Production R54/R84 blind retrieval lists (Blind-A) + the Blind-A source cache used for replay.

tarballs.name: r21_production.tar.gz
tarballs.why: R21/R39 retriever source (1 of 8 production sources; feeds the R54 LR and ensemble). 2.1GB on disk, compressed to ~1.81GB (npy index data compresses poorly).

already_on_drive.r54_phase3_full_folds1_4.zip: Folds 1-4 of the R54 phase-3 ensemble (model.safetensors + track_embs.npy + oof_lists.json each). Restored + validated 2026-06-04 (reproduces Blind-A R54 lists 80/80 identical). NOT re-duplicated here.
already_on_drive.r54_phase3_artifacts.zip: Earlier R54 phase-3 artifact bundle (also on Drive).
